verdict.rationale: Algolia documents official API clients for JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, Java, Swift, Kotlin and .NET, and states these clients are covered by its SLA. A migration skill for moving client code to the latest major version across those languages suggests the clients are actively versioned. On the framework side, InstantSearch covers React and vanilla JS, and the community cites coverage of Vue, Angular, iOS and Android and praises the React integration. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of release cadence or how current each SDK is, and independent hands-on corroboration of the backend-language clients beyond the docs listing.
